svg.aria-label: Two analytical diagrams. Left: persistent-state budget for 100M parameters over four devices, assuming 2-byte weights, 2-byte gradients, and 12-byte master weights plus Adam state; activations and temporary buffers are separate. Right: ideal forward scheduling for four microbatches and three equal-duration stages, labeled by microbatch, not a measured GPU trace.
